references.text: The prophet Isaiah also uses an image of a plant (in this case a vine) to convey a message about change and recognition, which can be seen as parallel to the use of the fig tree in Matthew.

Micah uses the image of a watchman and a fig tree to convey a message about vigilance and understanding the times, which resonates with the message in Matthew about recognizing the signs of the times.
Luke gives a parallel account to Matthew regarding the fig tree, emphasizing the importance of recognizing the signs of the times.
Mark includes a similar parable about the fig tree, serving to convey the same message about vigilance and understanding the signs of the end times.
